sn35.114:1.1: santi bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.114:1.2: tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.114:1.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu āvāsagato mārassa mārassa vasaṃ gato paṭimukkassa mārapāso
sn35.114:3.1: santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.114:3.2: tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.114:3.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu āvāsagato mārassa mārassa vasaṃ gato paṭimukkassa mārapāso
sn35.114:4.1: santi ca kho bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.114:4.2: tañce bhikkhu na abhinandati na abhivadati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.114:4.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu na āvāsagato mārassa mārassa vasaṃ gato ummukkassa mārapāso
sn35.114:4.4: mutto so mārabandhanena na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato …pe…
sn35.114:5.1: santi bhikkhave jivhāviññeyyā rasā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.114:5.2: tañce bhikkhu na abhinandati na abhivadati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.114:5.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu na āvāsagato mārassa mārassa vasaṃ gato ummukkassa mārapāso mutto so mārabandhanena na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato …pe…
sn35.114:6.1: santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.114:6.2: tañce bhikkhu na abhinandati na abhivadati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.114:6.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu na āvāsagato mārassa na mārassa vasaṃ gato ummukkassa mārapāso
sn35.114:6.4: mutto so mārabandhanena na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimatoti.
